summary: Tiny campus turning bay beside university buildings, busy with foot traffic.

best_section.where: small turning and parking bay east of the Global Change Institute

drivers.seclusion: No dwellings; university buildings 5-7 m on the west side and trees on the east, but students and staff pass constantly.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed road reaches the bay; room for a van is tight, with painted accessible bays on the west edge and one car parked on the east side.
drivers.traffic: Low vehicle traffic, heavy pedestrian use in the day.
drivers.convention: Mapped customer car park at 2 m; a campus bay used by day, overnight use unknown.

flags: Accessible bays marked beside the road
Slope up to 7% along the stretch, about 3% at the best section
sun_shade: Trees shade the east and north; buildings shade the west in the morning.
cannot_judge: Room for a van to turn
